note: Five separate stone pads strung along Medix Grade Road (shown as Medix Run Road in some apps) beside Medix Run, counted south from the Quehanna Highway: 001 at 0.45 mile on the east side, 002 at 0.6 mile, 003 and 004 side by side at 1.0 mile, 005 at 1.15 miles. Each is a shaded gravel back-in that the booking page lists as a moderate driveway grade, with a picnic table and 30 ft of overhead clearance; the pads are 15 to 20 ft wide, and the agency's campsite map layer says only 001, 002 and 005 have room for a camper with its awning out. Vehicles must stay on the stone pad. The stream is in the woods below the road, not at the pads. No toilet; drinking water is more than a quarter mile away. Pack out trash. --Claude
